validate_chairs: validate a RAFT optical flow model on the FlyingChairs dataset and print the EPE score
validate_sintel: validate a RAFT optical flow model on the Sintel training split for clean and final types
validate_kitti: validate a RAFT optical flow model on the KITTI-2015 training split and report EPE and F1
create_sintel_submission: create a Sintel leaderboard submission by running optical flow inference on the test split
create_kitti_submission: create a KITTI leaderboard submission by running optical flow inference on the KITTI test split
